Natural isotopologue ladders for xcms features

xcms_feature_natural_isotopologues.Rd

Finds natural-abundance isotopologues (13C, 2H, 15N, 18O, 34S, 37Cl, 81Br, 41K) among all features of one polarity, without chemical annotation or feature groups. Only isotopologues (different isotopic composition, different mass) are detected; isotopomers are not distinguishable by MS1 mass.

A feature pair is a candidate when its aggregated EIC similarity (otherData(xcms)$EIC_Similarity_agg) is above sim_threshold. The lighter feature is the parent; the m/z gap must match k times an isotope mass difference within ppm (standard ppm of the mean m/z). The abundance ceiling is prod(choose(n, k) * abundance^k) with n = floor(mz / major mass) for C/H/N/O and n = max_atoms for S/Cl/Br/K. A row is used only if the ceiling is at least min_rel (detectable k for that m/z) and the observed into ratio is at most ceiling times the factor (intensity_factor_chon or intensity_factor_hetero). 41K is used only in positive mode.

Parallel-ladder check: an S/Cl/Br step whose parent is itself an isotopologue is kept only if the monoisotopic root has the same step (same isotope and k) to a feature with higher median into. Dropped edges have pass_parallel = FALSE in pairs.

Each heavy feature keeps one parent, ordered by isotope priority (13C, then 15N/18O/2H, then 34S/37Cl/81Br, then 41K), |ppm| and similarity. Parents that are not linked to each other make the feature ambiguous. Parents are followed to the monoisotopic root; the cumulative composition is rechecked against the root (mass, min_rel, intensity), otherwise the direct parent is kept (chain_fallback).

Constants come from MSCC::elem_table.

Usage

xcms_feature_natural_isotopologues(
  xcms.xcms,
  polarity = c("Positive", "Negative"),
  sim_threshold = 0.9,
  ppm = 5,
  max_atoms = c(S = 3, Cl = 3, Br = 3, K = 1),
  intensity_factor_chon = 6,
  intensity_factor_hetero = 1.5,
  min_rel = 0.001
)

Arguments

xcms.xcms

xcms object with otherData(xcms)$EIC_Similarity_agg (see xcms_feature_EIC_similarity).

polarity

"Positive" or "Negative".

sim_threshold

numeric(1). Pairs need similarity strictly above this.

ppm

numeric(1). Tolerance of the m/z gap, ppm of the mean m/z.

max_atoms

Named integer. Maximum S, Cl, Br, K atoms per ion.

intensity_factor_chon

numeric(1). Allowed factor over the ceiling for C/H/N/O-only compositions.

intensity_factor_hetero

numeric(1). Allowed factor over the ceiling when S/Cl/Br/K is involved.

min_rel

numeric(1). Minimum theoretical ceiling for a k to be tried.

Value

Updated xcms.xcms. featureDefinitions gains isotopologue_status ("monoisotopic", "isotopologue", "ambiguous", "chain_fallback" or NA), isotopologue_anchor (own id for monoisotopic roots), isotopologue_formula, isotopologue_ppm, isotopologue_sim. otherData(xcms)$Isotopologue_Global holds params, summary, pairs, links, conflicts.
